a.title: • Descriptor: Use of a code for variable identification in the context of a data structure and a variable descriptor component.
a.xlink:title: • Descriptor: Use of a code for variable identification in the context of a data structure and a variable descriptor component.

a.title: • MeasureComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to hold the observed/derived values.
a.xlink:title: • MeasureComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to hold the observed/derived values.

a.title: • AttributeComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to qualify observations or provide other types of supplementary information.
a.xlink:title: • AttributeComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a data structure to qualify observations or provide other types of supplementary information.

a.title: • DimensionComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube".
a.xlink:title: • DimensionComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube".

a.title: • Population: Universe with time and geography specified.
a.xlink:title: • Population: Universe with time and geography specified.

a.title: • SentinelValueDomain: Value domain for a sentinel conceptual domain.
a.xlink:title: • SentinelValueDomain: Value domain for a sentinel conceptual domain.

a.title: • IdentifierComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a long or wide data structure to identify the units associated to data points, and in dimensional and key value data structures to provide identifying fields for the instance values.
a.xlink:title: • IdentifierComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a long or wide data structure to identify the units associated to data points, and in dimensional and key value data structures to provide identifying fields for the instance values.

a.title: • ValueMapping: Physical characteristics for the value of an instance variable stored in a data point as part of a physical segment layout.
a.xlink:title: • ValueMapping: Physical characteristics for the value of an instance variable stored in a data point as part of a physical segment layout.

a.title: • LogicalRecord: Collection of instance variables.
a.xlink:title: • LogicalRecord: Collection of instance variables.

a.title: • SubstantiveValueDomain: Value domain for a substantive conceptual domain. Typically a description and/or enumeration of allowed values of interest.
a.xlink:title: • SubstantiveValueDomain: Value domain for a substantive conceptual domain. Typically a description and/or enumeration of allowed values of interest.

a.title: • measures: The measures association is intended to describe specific relationships between the ConceptualVariable and UnitType classes, and similar relationships between their sub-classes. This is documented in section VII.D.5 of the "DDI-Cross Domain Integration: Detailed Model" document.
a.xlink:title: • measures: The measures association is intended to describe specific relationships between the ConceptualVariable and UnitType classes, and similar relationships between their sub-classes. This is documented in section VII.D.5 of the "DDI-Cross Domain Integration: Detailed Model" document.

a.title: • takesSubstantiveValuesFrom: The substantive representation (substantive value domain) of the variable. This is equivalent to the relationship "Measures" in the Generic Statistical Information Model (GSIM) although GSIM makes no distinction between substantive and sentinel values.
a.xlink:title: • takesSubstantiveValuesFrom: The substantive representation (substantive value domain) of the variable. This is equivalent to the relationship "Measures" in the Generic Statistical Information Model (GSIM) although GSIM makes no distinction between substantive and sentinel values.

a.title: • takesSentinelValuesFrom: A represented variable may have more than one sets of sentinel value domains, one for each type of software platform on which related instance variables might be instantiated. All of the sentinel value domains must have sentinel conceptual domains that correspond exactly. This allows codes for missing values to be explicitly matched across platforms.
a.xlink:title: • takesSentinelValuesFrom: A represented variable may have more than one sets of sentinel value domains, one for each type of software platform on which related instance variables might be instantiated. All of the sentinel value domains must have sentinel conceptual domains that correspond exactly. This allows codes for missing values to be explicitly matched across platforms.
